subject: Read-only installed Pack doctor
evidence: Exact installed Pack identity, status, deployment version and three persisted integrity digests are checked in one READ ONLY transaction
Validation report, signed trust snapshot, capability set and child registrations are bound by exact references, digests and declared identities
Unknown Pack fails closed as one PRECONDITION_FAILED violation without inventing a diagnostic
Partial fixture reports only validation, governance, capability registration and deployment-pointer gaps
limits: The doctor does not read Package payload bytes or repeat Cosign cryptographic verification
The doctor does not read the global migration Journal reserved to maintenance, and manifestMigrationCount is not migration completion
The doctor does not assert runtime availability, repair installation, change lifecycle state or grant execution authority
